statement: In fictional system eight, counter Z may pulse because part P stores charge and releases it at a threshold.
observation: Counter Z pulses about once every forty ticks.
run_a: In run A, the pulse interval rose from forty to sixty ticks when the storage of part P was doubled.
run_b: In run B, a rerun of the run A log with a second analysis script, the interval was again about sixty ticks.
prediction: If part P cannot store charge, Z stops pulsing.
